newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish yield curve seen steeper on key rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Finnish yield curve seen steeper on key rate cut.

text.p: The Finnish yield curve will steepen when the money and bond markets open on Wednesday after the Bank of Finland's surprise key rate cut in the morning, dealers said.

Long-term government bond yields were likely to ease just a few basis points while short money market rates would fall by up to 15 basis points following the central bank's tender rate cut to 3.10 percent from 3.25 percent, they said.
"The yield curve will steepen," OKOBANK Treasury economist Teijo Rantatupa said.
On Tuesday, the key 10-year government bond yield closed at 6.79 percent. The December FRA rate ended at 3.45 percent.
